cohort: 818 mothers who underwent cesarean section at University of Gondar Comprehensive Specialized Hospital from January 1, 2018, to January 1, 2019.
finding: The prevalence of SSI following cesarean delivery was 12.2%, and chorioamnionitis, diabetes mellitus, prolonged rupture of membranes, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, and anemia were significantly associated with SSI.
